svg.title: Incline tipping variables on the recorded reset state
svg.desc: a is half the base along the ramp; c is the perpendicular height from base midpoint T to the center of mass; theta is ramp inclination from horizontal; required x_cp is measured downhill from T and extends beyond a; mu_f is the box-ramp friction coefficient. An outlined diamond marks the required support point on top of the retained Drake recording.
